note: Blank recipe with every section for Ruby / Sapphire / Emerald. Replace null with piece numbers from your slice preview and delete the sections you don't need; anything left out or null falls back to another look or the game's own sprite. Use family "rse_wide" for 32-wide art. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

_how.piece: a number from the slice preview, e.g. 12
_how.one-row sections: can be a plain list, e.g. "back": [12, 13, 14]
_how.surf drawn with its mount: use "surf with blob": {"down": [4 pieces], "up": [...], "left": [...]} instead of "surf" and "surf blob"

_sections.front: front.png: 1 frame. battle front pic, also the trainer card
_sections.back: back.png: 4 frames. battle back pic: the throw first (wind-up, quick frame, thrown), idle LAST
_sections.walk: walk.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. stand, step, step
_sections.run: walk.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. run frames, in the game's order
_sections.mach bike: bike.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. stand, pedal, pedal
_sections.fish: fishing.png: 4 down, 4 up, 4 left. the cast, in order
_sections.map icon: mapIcon.png: 1 frame. 16x16 head for the town map
_sections.acro bike: acroBike.png: 9 down, 9 up, 9 left. first 3 ride like the Mach Bike, the rest are tricks (repeat the stand frame if you don't have them)
_sections.surf: surf.png: 4 down, 4 up, 4 left. sit, step, step, jump
_sections.underwater: underwater.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. diving, in the game's order
_sections.watering: watering.png: 3 down, 3 up, 3 left. watering, in the game's order
_sections.field move: fieldMove.png: 5 frames. using an HM, in order
_sections.surf blob: surfBlob.png (extras): 1 down, 1 up, 1 left. the surf mount (FRLG has 2 bob frames per facing)
_sections.fly bird: bird.png (extras): 1 frame. the Fly bird on its own
_sections.bag: bag.png (extras): 6 frames. bag picture(s) in the bag menu
